# Copilot workspace instructions

Follow the repository-wide [agent guide](../AGENTS.md) and [documentation index](../docs/README.md). The guide is tool-agnostic and is the canonical source for repository workflow, safety boundaries, source-of-truth order, story refinement, planning, and verification.

For file-specific work, read the relevant workspace manifest, source, tests, and configuration. Do not treat proposals under `sites/radio/plans/` as approved requirements without confirmation.

When asked to capture or refine future work, follow the [refined backlog workflow](../docs/backlog/README.md). Revalidate all linked context when picking up a card; keep its status, index entry, and delivery record current.
